name: Zul'Gurub: Delusions of Jin'do curses with its vision and one damage aura (#9661)
contract: Delusions of Jin'do puts the vision (2118511) and the damage (2118512) on its target, the two auras the
live logs show for every curse. The vision lets the cursed player see the Shade of Jin'do (14986) itself
(zul-gurub-jindo-shade-visible-with-the-vision), so the curse no longer adds vanilla's Delusions of
Jin'do (24306) as a third debuff (testers 2026-11-16: three debuffs). The lane's own phase makes Jin'do
lose the hero once 2118512 phases the hero (see zul-gurub-jindo-resets-5800), and the leave-combat
interrupt of 24306 would strip it then too, so the missing 24306 is a control here: the proof that
the vision alone reveals the shade is the sibling scenario.

steps.label: Delusions of Jin'do curses the hero
the curse's vision half also lands
